input.title: useCanExecute wraps evaluateActions for React and reports the flags-off case as status 'unsupported', which is not a denial

input.description: Returns status idle|loading|ready|unsupported|error plus evaluations, aggregates and refetch. Waits for the signed-in identity, re-evaluates when the revision moves; light client: always unsupported.
